item.title: 23 Aug 2026 10:30
item.description:
It’s here! This is an absolute piece of beauty and I can already imagine how this could be a wicked good hobby! So many ideas on how I want to stage this! This whole kit came decently packed but I did have to super-glue some components that had popped off or broken during transit. The WAP5 kit has the WAP5 Engine, 3 LHB Rajdhani coaches and an 18 inch radius oval track. For now, I’ve staged all of these scaled models in an infento case and over the next several days, I plan to design a modular and portable diorama so I can easily dismantle and store them. The engine zooms on these tracks and barely derails. The coaches on the other hand seem to be extremely sensitive to non-straight tracks. Quite likely because they’re so light [ ~100 gms]! I need to make sure when I set these rails in a diorama, I tether them to the base and then maybe add some extra load to make the coaches glide on the rails.

As I’m trying to imagine what I’d like this setup to look like here’s what I currently have in mind.

  • A long straight stretch ~ 12 ft long at the minimum and has space to hold atleast two HO tracks in parallel. This should give me enough distance to place a couple stations, some hill inclines and maybe a bridge? Ideally, I would like this to be built so I can add more blocks in between as my imagination evolves.
  • A corner block that let’s me build a proper rail junction. This would be the staging area for locomotives that aren’t actively running.

Fun upgrades:

  • Add realistic sound programming! That would be terrific!
  • Proper lighting at the rail level where the engine and locomotives are being staged.
  • An optimized switch system. The current switch control is bulky and non intuitive.
  • Sensor based tracks. The engine should stop when it senses an end of track. 🔗
